sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Singh, PP  Mr. O.P. Sangwa  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 20/07/2023 The present second bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.18/2022 registered at Police Station Nachana, District Jaisalmer for the offences punishable under Sections 304B, 316 and 498A of the IPC.
The first bail application was dismissed as not pressed by this Court vide order dated 07.09.2022 with liberty to file a fresh bail application after recording the statement of Smt. Shayari Devi.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that now Smt. Shayari Devi has been examined as PW.1 before the trial Court and there are material contradictions, improvements and omissions in her statements.

The petitioner is in judicial custody [2023:RJ-JD:22603] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8831/2023]
since 08.03.2022 and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner, Ramu Ram S/o Amedaram, shall be enlarged on bail in FIR No.18/2022 registered at Police Station Nachana, District Jaisalmer provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 200-Rashi/-
